files.description: Tested on men, prescribed to women: every novel drug approved since 2015 with a parsed FDA Drug Trials Snapshot, its FAERS adverse-event report split by sex, and (where available) MEPS prescription users by sex.

columns.brand: Brand name as on the FDA snapshot
columns.category: Therapeutic area assigned by keyword rules on the FDA indication text
columns.trial_n: Participants counted in the snapshot's demographics tables (may double-count overlapping populations; use the share, not the count)
columns.trial_female_pct: Share of pivotal-trial participants who were women
columns.enrollment_source: fda-snapshot, or carmeli-2023 where the archived page could not be retrieved
columns.faers_n: FAERS reports with a recorded sex (openFDA, brand-name query)
columns.faers_female_pct: Share of those reports from women
columns.gap: faers_female_pct minus trial_female_pct, percentage points; blank when faers_n is under 100
columns.sex_specific: male or female when the indication or the trial population is one sex; such drugs are excluded from gap comparisons
columns.meps_users_n: Unweighted MEPS person-years with a fill, 2018-2024
columns.meps_female_pct: Weighted share of users who are women
columns.rate_ratio: (female:male reports) / (female:male users); lo/hi are a 95% interval from the survey share's sampling error

files.description: The urgency gap: survey-weighted estimates by patient sex for NHAMCS ED visits 2018-2022, adults 18+, by pain complaint and for heart-attack visits.

columns.complaint: Reason-for-visit group (abdominal, chest, back, headache, limb, flank, all) or heart_attack (ICD-10 I21/I22 in any diagnosis)
columns.measure: See the Methods page: shares are percentages, wait_mean and lov_mean are minutes, tests_count is a count
columns.women_n/men_n: Unweighted sampled visits in the estimate
columns.lo/hi: 95% confidence interval, Taylor linearization over strata and PSUs

files.description: The urgency gap: the same estimates by complaint and age band (18-44, 45-64, 65+, all).
The research dollar: 67 diseases with NIH FY2024 funding matched to WHO 2021 US burden by sex.

columns.female_share: Share of DALYs falling on women
columns.disability_share: YLD as a share of DALYs
columns.expected_m: Fitted funding from the power law of funding on burden
columns.skew: female (>=60% women), male (>=60% men) or balanced

files.description: The research dollar: NIH funding by fiscal year 2008-2025 for each matched disease, $ millions (0 means the category was not yet reported).
The research dollar: NIH-funded conditions with no WHO burden estimate, FY2024 funding in $ millions.

Who gets studied: for each disease, US interventional trials with posted results on ClinicalTrials.gov, women's share of participants against women's share of US burden (WHO 2021), by sponsor, and what the eligibility text excludes.

columns.female_pct: Women as a share of participants with a recorded sex, all trials
columns.female_pct_open: Same, trials open to both sexes only
columns.excl_preg_pct: Share of trials whose criteria exclude pregnant women
columns.max_age_pct: Share with an upper age limit
columns.outcome_by_sex: Trials reporting any outcome in sex-named groups
columns.over65_trial_pct: Share of participants aged 65+ in trials reporting age categories
columns.burden_65plus_pct: Share of US DALYs after 65 (70+ band plus half of 60-69)

files.description: Who gets studied: by trial start year, women's share of participants (trials open to both sexes, non sex-specific conditions) and the share of all US trials with each exclusion.

Where the diagnosis gap lives: survey-weighted estimates by patient sex for NHAMCS ED visits 2018-2022, adults 18+, non-injury, by symptom complaint: symptom-code diagnoses, anxiety codes, tests, imaging, admission and 72-hour returns.

columns.measure: See the Methods page; shares are percentages, tests_count a count, lov_mean minutes

files.description: Where the diagnosis gap lives: SEER stage at diagnosis (2013-2022) and median age at diagnosis (2018-2022) by sex for cancers both sexes get.

columns.distant_*_pct: Share of new cases diagnosed at distant stage
columns.distant_age_adj_*: Same, standardised to the site's pooled age distribution in three bands

files.description: Where the diagnosis gap lives: adjusted odds ratios for women relative to men from survey-weighted logistic regressions.
Where the diagnosis gap lives: the same estimates by complaint and age band.
The male default body: what the current FDA label of each chapter-1 drug says about sex, pregnancy and breastfeeding, classified by the published rules.

columns.sex_statement: Classification of the pharmacology section's statement about sex
columns.male_only_pk: Pharmacokinetics reported from healthy male subjects
columns.no_preg_data: Label says human pregnancy data are absent, limited or insufficient

files.description: The male default body: PubMed record counts by year and sex check tag for rodent studies (overall, by field, NIH-funded) and human trial reports.

columns.n: Records in the series that year
columns.n_sexed: Records carrying a Male or Female tag
columns.male_only_pct: Male and not Female, as a share of n_sexed
